_doc: Every job the worker box runs. tier: script (no AI, free), cli (Claude Code or Codex on a flat subscription; cli lists the order to try, the next one takes over when one is out of usage or fails), hermes (an agent loop on a capped model key; only where a job needs one). started_by: a cron line (UTC, in crontab.txt) or 'order' (a desk work order from GrokBot). Grok never runs these; it only writes orders and reads results.

signals.does: Daily signals for the watchlist from free public candles; paper trades only on the signal rules

paper-mark.does: Mark open paper positions at the public price; weekly report on Sundays

coin-check.does: Free-API checks on coins Grok's X scout found: liquidity, age, volume, pairs, red flags

sales.does: Gumroad sales, read-only, when a read token is set

digest.does: One short digest of the last day for Grok's morning plan

watchdog.does: Alarm to Slack when Grok or the worker is silent over 26 hours, or a job failed twice

dev-build.does: Code out a dev idea in builds/dev/<slug>/ with the software-factory rules

vet.does: Vet an idea out of 25 with web research; place it on the board

factory-run.does: Pick, spec, build, test and package one product up to Ready for review

creator-follow.does: Read each creator's new public ideas; write testable strategy specs

algo-lab.does: Code and backtest queued strategy specs on historical data, out of sample

hermes-build.does: Design and build a Hermes agent pack; install only on a computer Justin named

ask.does: Anything else Grok hands over that needs an agent loop
